title: Antisemitism adviser to launch inquiry into ‘hostile work environment’ at BBC
summary: John Mann says he is conducting review after hearing ‘disturbing’ accounts of discrimination from Jewish staff

blocks.text:
John Mann says he is conducting review after hearing ‘disturbing’ accounts of discrimination from Jewish staff

  • UK politics live – latest updates

The government’s independent adviser on antisemitism has said he is launching an investigation into the BBC after hearing “disturbing” accounts from Jewish staff of discrimination against them.

John Mann, the Labour peer and former MP, said BBC whistleblowers had told him they faced a “hostile work environment” at the broadcaster and that his previous warnings to its management had gone unheeded.
